summary: A universally false literal adjacency predicate in Lemma3.9 is directly used by the core combinatorial-rigidity argument; a four-distinct-vertex correction is analytically verified.

problems.title: Unrestricted auxiliary vertices invalidate Lemma3.9
problems.source_claim: Adjacency iff Lambda12 nonempty and no u3,u4 satisfy Lambda12 subseteq Lambda34 and Lambda34=Lambda3i for some i=1,2
assumptions: u1,u2 type a and strictly comparable

counterexample.parameters: m=1,n=2; u2 corresponds to <a>,u1 to t<a>
counterexample.hypotheses_verified: Height distinguishes a-lines, positive t-edge gives adjacent comparable tree vertices; <t> meets both lines, hence Lambda12 nonempty
counterexample.stated_result: Adjacent endpoints must have no witness
counterexample.actual_result: Lambda34=Lambda32=Lambda12, so both witness conditions hold; no-witness predicate false while adjacency true

counterevidence: Actual source PNG confirms subseteq and unrestricted witness domain
Source proof implicitly assumes distinctness, indicating intended repair
problems.core_dependency: Lemma3.9 -> Proposition3.1 tree adjacency preservation (p22) -> Proposition4.3 interlocking order rigidity (p25) -> Theorem4.2 -> Theorem1.5 and Theorem1.1 application (p31)
problems.impact_boundary: Literal core-dependent lemma invalid; no counterexample to main measure-equivalence theorem; journal-final text uninspected

repair.statement: Require u3,u4 outside {u1,u2} and u3!=u4, retaining original assumptions and witness relations
repair.verification: General proof using Cor3.7 in report Proposition1; adjacent case excludes all distinct witnesses; nonadjacent case constructs u4<u2<u3<u1 on common t-line

independent_acceptance_check.assumptions_checked: m=1,n=2 are nonzero, |m|<|n| and m divides n; <a> and t<a> are distinct strictly comparable adjacent a-lines and share <t>.
independent_acceptance_check.decisive_check: The explicitly permitted u3=u1,u4=u2,i=2 makes both witness relations equalities. The source image confirms subseteq and no endpoint exclusion. The printed no-witness criterion therefore fails for an actual adjacent pair.
independent_acceptance_check.repair_check: With four vertices distinct, any common t-line orders them. Corollary3.7 excludes witnesses above or between adjacent endpoints and gives strict link inequality for either order of two lower witnesses; nonadjacent endpoints admit u4<u2<u3<u1 with required equalities. This proves the local corrected statement throughout the original parameter domain.
independent_acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_impact: Source proof implicitly expects distinct vertices, but the literal criterion is systematically false and is explicitly invoked by Proposition3.1 p22, Proposition4.3 p25 and the main application p31. Short repair does not downgrade this demonstrated core-dependent false lemma; no counterexample to measure equivalence rigidity.
independent_acceptance_check.scope: Single existing Problem; no full groupoid or W* reproof.

other_checked_claims.argument: Common subgroup <b^n> fixes distinct v,w,tw; valid for signed parameters and |m|=1.
